_readme: Card shows near Rochester, NY, Buffalo and Syracuse, rendered by
scripts/build-shows.mjs onto /card-shows.html.
HAND MAINTAINED ON PURPOSE. There is no free API for local card shows, and
the aggregators that do exist disagree with each other (see the note on
POKEFEST below). So every event here was read off a real listing and carries
the url it came from, plus the date it was checked. Nothing is inferred.
ADDING AN EVENT
1. Copy the block below, change the fields, keep the id unique.
2. `date` is ISO, YYYY-MM-DD. `start`/`end` are 24h, HH:MM.
3. Drop a flyer image in public/assets/shows/ and put the FILENAME ONLY in
`flyer`. Any size or shape works, the page crops it.
4. Re-run: node scripts/build-shows.mjs
PAST EVENTS LOOK AFTER THEMSELVES. The build drops anything already gone and
the page hides stragglers on load too, so a stale build never shows a date
that has been and gone. Leave old entries here as a record if you like.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT
- Southern Tier shows (Endicott, Elmira Heights, Nichols). They turn up in
the same regional feeds but they are two and a half to three hours from
Rochester, NY and closer to Binghamton than to any of the three cities.
- Any event whose date could not be confirmed on a real listing. The WNY
Sports Card Expo is in `watchFor` instead: a real recurring show with no
announced next date. Move an entry out of `watchFor` and into `shows` as
soon as it has one, the way RocPokeCon moved once Halloween was posted.
OPTIONAL FIELDS worth knowing about, both used by RocPokeCon:
- `featured: true` gives an event the gold treatment and a 'The big one'
flag. Meant for one show at a time, or it stops meaning anything.
- `tiers` renders a price table and feeds the Offer structured data. Use it
when a show has real ticket levels; `admission` alone is fine otherwise.
- `ticketUrl` adds a Get tickets button next to the site link.

- `phone` renders a call-or-text link and feeds the organizer's structured data. Only for a number the organizer PUBLISHES for the show, e.g. off their own flyer; never a personal number and never one scraped from somewhere it was not offered for contact.
- Admission prices that were not stated. An unstated price shows as
'Check the listing' rather than a guess, because turning up expecting free
entry and finding a cover charge is exactly the sort of wrong this page
must not be.
REGIONS drive the filter chips: roc, buffalo, syracuse.

VENDORS. A show may carry `vendors`: [{ name, confirmed }]. `name` must match a vendor in data/vendors.json EXACTLY (trimmed, case-insensitive) -- it is a foreign key, so renaming a vendor there fails this build until the shows are updated too. `confirmed` is REQUIRED and must be a non-empty sentence saying who confirmed it and when; it prints under that vendor's name. A name with no listing, a missing or blank `confirmed`, a duplicate vendor or a null entry all FAIL the build, because a confirmed vendor that silently does not render is a typo shaped like a correct build.

shows.name: Northtowns Card & Memorabilia Show
shows.pkmnWhy: A collector who has been reported it on r/Buffalo, 1 September 2026: "The Northtown Card show in Sanborn is very Pokemon heavy." That is a first-hand account rather than the organiser or a listing, and it is recorded as one.

shows.name: Arch Angels Collectors Show
shows.blurb: A charity show for Archangel School, run by the people behind the Batavia shows. Free to get in, with food and refreshments on site. Six foot vendor tables are $40, and the number to call about one is on the flyer.
shows.source: the organizer's own flyer, sent to the channel by a reader on Discord, August 27, 2026
shows.sourceNote: The name and the venue spelling come from the flyer itself now rather than from the aggregator that first listed this show: that read "Arch Angel Sports Card and Collectors Show" at "Arch Angel School", and the flyer says Arch Angels Collectors Show at Archangel School. Everything the aggregator had that the flyer also states, the date, 10am to 3pm, free admission and the Chili Avenue address, matched exactly, which is why nothing else moved. The Pokemon mark also moved: this entry read "Pokemon not confirmed" until the flyer arrived, which was honest at the time and is now out of date. THE EVIDENCE FOR pkmn:some IS THE FLYER ITSELF, which is built around a Pokeball drawn as large as the show title, and that is the first of the three kinds build-shows.mjs allows. It was on the page as pkmnWhy for one build and the owner asked for it to come off, so it lives here instead: the chip still has to be justified even where the justification is not printed. It is the one show on the r/Rochester post that was listed as unconfirmed, so that post is now wrong about it.

shows.source: fc3roc.com/showinfo for the dates, hours and prices, read 3 September 2026, plus Legends Card Shop's own flyer for the fact that a Pokemon vendor is there; organiser read off fc3roc.com, which states the con is "produced by the Mighty Monkey Corporation, a 501(c)(3) corporation", 4 September 2026
shows.blurb: A comic con rather than a card show, and it is here for the same reason the Excalibur weekend is: the vendor hall. shows.name: Excalibur Events: Niagara Falls Premodern/Pauper Weekend
shows.address: 101 Old Falls St, Niagara Falls, NY 14303
shows.blurb: The Friday is the vendor evening rather than a tournament day: the hall is open 3pm to 9pm and the mains do not start until Saturday. A collector on r/Buffalo, who found these hours, cautions that there is no guarantee every vendor is set up that night and suggests asking Card Garden or Rochester CCG first. A Magic: The Gathering tournament weekend, not a walk-in card show, and it is here because of the vendor hall: Card Garden, Rochester CCG, The Mana Mart and The Slaughterhouse Games are all listed. Playing costs $90 for the Premodern main and $70 for the Legacy. Excalibur publish no price for walking in just to browse, so check before you drive.
shows.source: excaliburevents.net, the organizer's own site: the Event Hours block reads Friday 3PM-9PM, Saturday 8AM-9PM, Sunday 8AM-6PM. Read 1 September 2026, after a reader on r/Buffalo pointed at the Friday hours this file had missed.

shows.name: The Big Show
shows.farAfield: The owner, 3 September 2026: "its still driving distance from Rochester, NY so its worth adding to the show page list". TOAK Pulls are vending it. 208 miles from Rochester, NY, well past the 45 mile rule, and here on that decision rather than by accident.
shows.source: the organiser's flyer, sent to the channel by TOAK Pulls 3 September 2026, and checked against northpittsportscards.com listings for the same dates, times and prices
shows.blurb: A Pittsburgh-area show and by some way the farthest thing on this page: about three and a half hours from Rochester, NY, so it is a day out rather than a Saturday morning. Over 200 tables, sports cards and TCG together, with Pokemon billed. VIP is $12 and gets you in two hours early with a welcome gift; general admission is $5 after that. Run by North Pittsburgh Sports Cards, whose poster also carries a separate fundraiser show in September. Not to be confused with the other Big Show Card Show, which is in Breinigsville at the far end of the state.
shows.pkmnWhy: The flyer bills "Sports Cards, TCG, Pokemon, Memorabilia", so Pokemon is named but it is a sports-led show.

_towns_note: TOWN CENTRES, NOT VENUES, and that is deliberate. [lat, lon] geocoded once by
hand from OpenStreetMap Nominatim on August 17, 2026 and stored here so no
build touches the network. Only 3 of the 8 venues on this page carry a street
address at all; the rest are named places like 'Quality Inn, Batavia'. Across a
map that spans 150 miles from Niagara Falls to Syracuse, a town centre is the
honest unit and the caption says so. A dot is never dropped for a town that is
not in here: the builder leaves it off the map and warns instead.
ONE RESULT HAD TO BE RE-QUERIED. 'Niagara Falls, New York' returns the
WATERFALL from Nominatim, type 'waterfall', not the city. It is only a couple
of miles out and would have looked entirely correct on a map at this scale,
which is exactly why it is written down. The coordinate here is the one for
'City of Niagara Falls, Niagara County', type 'administrative'.
ADDING A TOWN: geocode '<Town>, <County> County, New York, USA', check the
type comes back administrative or census rather than something on the
landscape, and put [lat, lon] in here to six places.
